sections.name: ScoreboardsPage
sections.title: Admin dashboard page
sections.what: Checks for an admin, builds the data, and lays out trust, product, learning and business figures. Non-admins get a not-found page.
sections.why: Likely reason: one page gathers every health number so the team can check them together, and the force-dynamic setting makes it fresh on every visit.
sections.watch_out: The page cuts date text by position, so a change in the time format would show wrong dates.

summary: An internal admin dashboard that shows trust, product, learning and business numbers, and returns a not-found page to anyone who is not an admin.
purpose: Lets the team check the health of the app and its data without showing these numbers to fans.
why: The page is hidden from search engines and returns not-found to non-admins, which keeps internal numbers private.
how: 1) Checks the visitor is an admin and stops with a not-found page if not. 2) Builds the scoreboard data. 3) Formats each rate as a percentage with its counts, or shows a no-data message. 4) Lays the figures out in four labelled sections.
inputs: The admin session check in the admin providers and the scoreboard builder in the scoreboards service.
outputs: A server-rendered page with the four sections of figures.
risks: The page relies on date text being in a set format, and a change in the builder's output format would break the displayed dates.
debug: If a figure looks wrong, check the matching function in the scoreboards service. If the page shows not-found, check the admin session first. If a date is cut badly, check the format of the generated time value.
